validations_executed.evidence: New renderer converts executive-report.json into a Northvalley-branded LaTeX/PDF using the repo's existing brand assets: cover with evidence-basis card, executive summary with scorecard and metric cards, findings with opportunity matrix, and a dedicated What This Report Does Not Claim page with evidence references. Pink Lily and Dress Up PDFs both compile (4 pages, US Letter).

validations_executed.tool: pdfinfo, pdftotext, pdftoppm rendered page review
validations_executed.evidence: Rendered page images reviewed: cover, summary, findings, and limitations pages are non-blank and readable. Two layout defects found and fixed during review: the cover date clipped under the corner accent (moved left) and the summary page columns misaligned on first baseline (lead dark card added). Text extraction confirms title, no-re-inspection statement, limitations section, and brand closeout.

The executive-report API now renders the PDF when latexmk is available (graceful note when not); validator asserts PDF existence, page count of at least 3, and whitespace-normalized text content. Detail view exposes pdf_path and the artifact route serves application/pdf. Open PDF link verified live in the browser.
All suites pass; the run validator already excludes downstream executive/ artifacts from the artifact-index check, so PDF and tex artifacts do not disturb inspection validation.
Framework validator passes; BDD-012 calibration remains the known deferred warning.

notes: Implementation changed after VAL-055, so the GEN-014 clean-pass count restarts: VAL-056 is pass one for the current state. The charter deliverable is now a branded, sendable PDF produced entirely from retained inspection evidence. Content-integrity note: generated PDFs carry only evidence-backed claims and explicit limitations; no invented proof or peer comparisons.
